# =====================================================================
# The Sefarim ledger's rite selector (2026-11-10, Daniel: "a selector to view
# book ledgers of other rites and see how they view the world's books'
# standings, with our own rite's icon shown by default"). gui/kehillah_sefarim_
# ledger.gui reads the standings through kehillah_lib_rite_standing_<flag>
# (rite scope, generated by scripts/kehillah_library_catalog.py).
# Record: docs/implementation/2026-11-08-library-visual-pass.md.
# =====================================================================

# Scope: the viewer, as the ledger opens. Lists the living rites of every
# Jewish faith on var list kehillah_ledger_rites, the viewer's own first, and
# shows the viewer's own rite.
kehillah_ledger_refresh_rites_effect = {
	clear_variable_list = kehillah_ledger_rites
	if = {
		limit = { exists = rite }
		rite = { save_scope_as = kehillah_ledger_own_rite }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ledger_rites target = scope:kehillah_ledger_own_rite }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_ledger_rite value = scope:kehillah_ledger_own_rite }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = var:kehillah_ledger_rite }
		remove_variable = kehillah_ledger_rite
	}
	religion:judaism_religion = {
		every_faith = {
			every_faith_rite = {
				limit = {
					is_inactive_rite = no
					NOT = { root.rite ?= this }
				}
				save_scope_as = kehillah_ledger_other_rite
				root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ledger_rites target = scope:kehillah_ledger_other_rite } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = var:kehillah_ledger_rite } }
		random_in_list = {
			variable = kehillah_ledger_rites
			save_scope_as = kehillah_ledger_first_rite
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:kehillah_ledger_first_rite }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_ledger_rite value = scope:kehillah_ledger_first_rite }
		}
	}
}

# 2026-11-10 (Daniel: "a way to view other rites' and religions' book tiers
# and known books"). Scope: the viewer. Rebuilds kehillah_lib_catalog_works
# for the rite the ledger shows: the viewer's own community's known works, or
# the works another rite's followers know (kehillah_lib_refresh_rite_catalog_*,
# generated). var:kehillah_ledger_by_name holds the chosen order, and
# var:kehillah_ledger_faith the shown rite's faith, for the selector's label.
kehillah_ledger_rebuild_effect = {
	var:kehillah_ledger_rite ?= {
		rite_faith ?= { save_scope_as = kehillah_ledger_shown_faith }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:kehillah_ledger_shown_faith }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_ledger_faith value = scope:kehillah_ledger_shown_faith }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_ledger_other_rite_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = kehillah_ledger_by_name }
			kehillah_lib_refresh_rite_catalog_name_effect = yes
		}
		else = { kehillah_lib_refresh_rite_catalog_list_effect = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = kehillah_ledger_by_name }
		kehillah_lib_refresh_catalog_name_effect = yes
	}
	else = { kehillah_lib_refresh_catalog_list_effect = yes }
}
